scope: Public resource directory; research and education only

resources.name: BrainXell BrainBloX
resources.purpose: Modular human iPSC-derived central nervous system cultures, cocultures and spheroids
resources.limitations: Physical cells and custom platforms are not free; CNS models do not automatically represent peripheral nerve tumors

resources.name: BrainXell Resource Library
resources.purpose: Posters, protocols, publications and videos on human neuronal models
resources.limitations: Availability of individual downloadable materials or reuse licenses varies

resources.name: NIH NCATS Tissue Chip Program
resources.access: Free public information; chips not supplied free
resources.purpose: Organ-on-chip principles, projects and research partnerships
resources.limitations: Program resources are not equivalent to free tissue-chip hardware or experiment access

resources.name: NIEHS NICEATM / ICCVAM Resources
resources.purpose: Alternative method validation, qualification, regulatory guidance and data
resources.limitations: Guidelines do not validate an individual experimental model by themselves

resources.name: EPA CompTox Chemicals Dashboard
resources.integration: Public APIs and downloads; confirm terms
resources.purpose: Chemical bioactivity, hazard and computational toxicology, including NAM assays
resources.limitations: Toxicity screens are not evidence that a substance treats cancer

resources.name: SPARC Portal
resources.purpose: Peripheral nervous-system anatomy, functional physiology datasets and models
resources.limitations: Multi-species data; neural maps do not directly establish cancer signaling

resources.name: NCI Patient-Derived Models Repository
resources.access: Public genomic data; physical models fee-based
resources.integration: Public data download; material requests separately
resources.purpose: Patient-derived organoids, cell cultures, xenografts and associated data
resources.limitations: Materials require application, fees and qualified facilities

resources.name: CancerModels.Org
resources.access: Free public discovery portal; model acquisition varies
resources.purpose: Cross-repository catalog of patient-derived cancer models and their annotations
resources.limitations: Some listed models belong to commercial suppliers or require material transfer agreements

resources.name: DepMap
resources.purpose: CRISPR gene essentiality, cancer cell lines, drug-response and gene expression
resources.limitations: Cell-line dependencies are not personalized tumor treatment evidence

resources.name: cBioPortal
resources.purpose: Visualize cancer alterations, multiomic profiles and cohort findings
resources.limitations: Many studies are not representative of rare tumor subtypes

resources.name: NCI Genomic Data Commons (GDC)
resources.access: Free public subset; controlled data require authorization
resources.integration: Public API and bulk data download
resources.purpose: Harmonized genomic and clinical cancer datasets, including TCGA
resources.limitations: Controlled files require dbGaP approval; respect data-use policies

resources.name: NCI Proteomic Data Commons (PDC)
resources.purpose: Proteomic datasets linking tumors with protein abundance
resources.limitations: Availability and suitability differ by tumor type

resources.name: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO)
resources.purpose: Gene-expression experiments including injury, perturbation and drug studies
resources.limitations: Sample annotation and experimental design vary widely; validate washout and controls

resources.name: CZ CELLxGENE Discover
resources.purpose: Search and visualize single-cell data and cell-type-specific gene expression
resources.limitations: Cell-type harmonization, disease representation and batch effects require review

resources.name: Cell Model Passports
resources.purpose: Cancer cell model annotations, genomics, drug sensitivity and gene dependency
resources.limitations: Physical model access is separate; model annotations must be checked

resources.name: Human Protein Atlas
resources.integration: Public browsing and downloadable data subject to conditions
resources.purpose: Protein and RNA expression by tissue, cell type and cancer
resources.limitations: Antibody and expression estimates require evidence-level checks

resources.name: Human BioMolecular Atlas Program (HuBMAP)
resources.access: Open atlas; dataset-specific restrictions may apply
resources.purpose: Normal human tissue, spatial and single-cell molecular maps
resources.limitations: Healthy tissue references do not reproduce diseased tumor tissue

resources.name: EMBL-EBI Expression Atlas
resources.purpose: Curated patterns of RNA/protein expression across tissues and conditions
resources.limitations: Cross-experiment normalization and organism differences matter

resources.name: Reactome
resources.purpose: Curated reactions and pathways linking genes to biological processes
resources.limitations: Pathway association does not establish causality in a tumor

resources.name: STRING
resources.purpose: Functional protein associations and network enrichment
resources.limitations: Networks include predicted and indirect associations; scores are not proof of contact

resources.name: Open Targets Platform
resources.purpose: Disease–target evidence, candidate drugs and target prioritization
resources.limitations: Association scores are prioritization aids, not patient-level efficacy

resources.name: ChEMBL
resources.access: Free public bioactivity database; CC BY-SA 3.0
resources.purpose: Compound bioactivity, drug-like molecules and biological targets
resources.limitations: In-vitro activity is not clinical efficacy; license requires attribution/share-alike where applicable

resources.name: PubChem
resources.purpose: Chemical structures, properties, biological assays and identifiers
resources.limitations: Third-party annotations have separate provenance and reuse terms

resources.name: CIViC Cancer Variant Knowledgebase
resources.purpose: Evidence-linked cancer molecular variants and clinical assertions
resources.limitations: Educational use; curator submissions have varying review status; not clinical decision software

resources.name: PhysiCell
resources.purpose: Agent-based multicellular tumor and tissue simulation
resources.limitations: Requires mechanistic assumptions and experimental calibration; not for individual medical decisions

resources.name: Morpheus
resources.purpose: Cellular Potts, PDE/ODE and multiscale simulation with GUI
resources.limitations: Model parameters and biological validity remain investigator responsibility

resources.name: BioModels
resources.purpose: Reuse curated computational models of biochemical systems
resources.limitations: Published models can be context-specific and need independent validation

resources.name: PubMed
resources.access: Free search; some publisher full texts paywalled
resources.purpose: Find indexed biomedical studies and abstracts
resources.limitations: Not all articles are free full text; publication is not proof of quality

resources.name: Europe PMC
resources.access: Free search and open-access texts where licensed
resources.purpose: Search papers, preprints and accessible full-text literature
resources.limitations: Licensing varies by article; distinguish preprints from peer-reviewed papers

resources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
resources.purpose: Search interventional and observational studies, status and eligibility
resources.limitations: Recruitment status changes; registry listing does not prove eligibility or effectiveness

resources.name: NCI ITCR Open Tool Catalog
resources.access: Free for academic/nonprofit use; individual licenses vary
resources.purpose: Directory of cancer analytics, imaging, genomics and clinical informatics tools
resources.limitations: Do not assume every tool permits commercial reuse or is hosted free of charge

resources.name: Galaxy Training Network
resources.purpose: Hands-on training in bioinformatics and reproducible analysis
resources.limitations: Tutorials may require separate data download or compute capacity

resources.name: The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA)
resources.access: Many open collections; some controlled or license-restricted
resources.purpose: Public cancer imaging collections, including radiology and pathology
resources.limitations: Each collection has separate access/license constraints; research images not a diagnostic service

resources.name: 3D Slicer
resources.purpose: Medical-image visualization, segmentation, quantitative analysis
resources.limitations: Research use needs validated workflows; not automatically approved for clinical use

resources.name: Galaxy / UseGalaxy
resources.access: Free public server with usage quotas
resources.purpose: Run bioinformatics pipelines without managing servers
resources.limitations: Public instances have quotas and are unsuitable for uploading identifiable patient records

resources.name: Bioconductor
resources.purpose: Reproducible RNA-seq, genomics and multiomics workflows
resources.limitations: Requires R and analysis expertise; compute/data costs separate

resources.name: Kaggle Notebooks
resources.purpose: Python/R execution and limited free accelerators for demonstrations
resources.limitations: Free computing availability and quotas change; no confidential data in public notebooks

resources.name: GitHub Pages
resources.access: Free hosting for public repositories on GitHub Free
resources.purpose: Deploy searchable static resource catalog at zero hosting cost
resources.limitations: GitHub Free requires public repository for Pages; avoid secrets and private data

resources.name: Cloudflare Pages
resources.purpose: Alternative hosting for static directory
resources.limitations: Check usage quotas, platform terms and advanced function costs

resources.name: NCI AI in Cancer Research Resources
resources.integration: Links to external tools and resources
resources.purpose: NCI-curated index of AI/ML cancer models and software
resources.limitations: Tools linked from directory may have separate eligibility and use restrictions

resources.name: UCSC Xena
resources.integration: Public data hubs and software tools
resources.purpose: Explore gene expression and clinical patterns across public cohorts
resources.limitations: Correlative visualizations do not establish patient-level relationships
